runtime_repair.reason: Original Windows MKL feature producer and remote Linux OpenBLAS differ on one near-zero slope; exact equality retained by using the original producer runtime.

pipeline_cost.scope: Filtered existing source-table reads, aggregation, frozen normalization and dense materialization on the original local feature-production CPU; model inference was measured separately on the remote GPU.
pipeline_cost.cache_policy: OS cache not flushed. Source hashes checked before and after all measurements; verification cost reported separately.
pipeline_cost.limitation: eICU feature-pipeline timing uses a different CPU/runtime from the remote database timings and GPU inference; no direct cross-host speed comparison. Three fixed subset sizes do not establish distributed scalability.

self_test: cluster-multiplicity review budgets match explicit duplicate-patient example
ties resolved by fixed stay ID; no label-dependent ties
limitations: Intervals condition on fixed models, observed cohorts and the chosen validation baseline; historical test exposure and training-population uncertainty are not included.
Subgroups are exploratory, not causal effects or proof of subgroup equivalence; calibration uses the same overall Validation-fitted calibrator.
Early-death exclusion is an outcome-conditioned retrospective LOS sensitivity analysis, not a replacement label, survival model or prospective deployment population.
Stress inputs are synthetic; MIMIC-III timing is specimen-based and does not establish measured result-availability robustness.
